description: This file provides functions for loading and saving data to backup RAM registers, identified by enumeration indices, with conditional compilation based on RTC usage.

methods.name: backupRamLoad
methods.description: Returns the value stored in backup RAM at the index specified by 'idx'.

methods.name: backupRamSave
methods.description: Saves the provided 'value' into backup RAM at the index specified by 'idx'.
